cells.tense: You are holding right now, and the holding is coming from what is inside you, not from what you are handed.
cells.ask: Pick one small thing that only matters to you and give it twenty minutes today, no audience, no report back to anyone.
cells.core:
You are in the middle of a stretch that is costing you something material, and you are getting through it with what you have inside you. No one is watching and that has not stopped you. The strength is not borrowed and it is not loud — it is the plain fact that you keep going and the going is yours.

What is worth noticing is that this is happening while almost nothing is decided yet. You are still at the point where everything could be, and you are proving you can hold while none of it has taken shape. Carry one small private thing through to the end of it today. The persistence you have is real, and it is the kind that stays standing when the outcome is still open.
cells.sheetLine: You are holding this with your own hands, and no one had to hand it to you.
cells.verb: holding through material weight by your own private resources
cells.place: where everything is still possible and nothing has been chosen

cells.tense: You are bracing for a weight that has not arrived yet, treating what might come as something you already have to carry.
cells.ask: Name one thing you are carrying for someone before they asked, and hand it back to them today — actually tell them it is theirs.
cells.core:
You are preparing for material difficulty that has not shown up. Somewhere ahead of you there is a version where things get hard, and you are already holding the shape of it, rehearsing the load. Bracing is not the same as carrying, and it costs you the same strength.

What you have is real persistence. What is doing the damage is that it is aimed at a future instead of the thing in front of you. You can hold what is here. You cannot hold what has not happened, and trying is pulling you out of the room you are actually in. Let one load stay where it belongs, with the person who owns it, and see what your strength feels like when it is not reaching ahead of itself.

cells.tense: You stopped drawing on your own strength a while back, and you have been getting through without it since then.
cells.ask: Tell one person about something you carried through and finished, out loud, and let them say something back about it.
cells.core:
You have the strength in you and you are not using it. Carrying things on your own stopped being worth the effort, so you set it down and did not pick it back up. Nothing has collapsed. You are just getting through on less than what you have.

The endurance is still yours. What is missing is any point in reaching for it — no one has seen what you already carried, and carrying more for nobody is hard to justify. You are still at the point where everything could be, and you are not moving toward any of it. Let one person see something you held through and finished. That is not asking to be praised. It is letting the strength have a floor to land on again.
cells.sheetLine: The strength is still there. You stopped reaching for it.

cells.tense: You are already persisting through this with your own resources, and you are telling yourself it is just how things are.
cells.ask: Say out loud that you are the one holding this, to yourself, once — then pick one thing you have carried and mark it as finished.
cells.core:
You are getting through something under real material pressure, and the strength is coming from inside you. That part is running fine. What has not happened is your claim on it. You describe the getting through as just what happens, as if the strength belonged to the situation.

It is yours and you have not said so. This is happening while almost nothing has been decided yet — you are still before the choice that makes any of it concrete — and you are already showing what you can carry. The persistence will keep working whether or not you take credit for it. Take credit anyway, once, plainly. The person doing this deserves to know who it is.
